instruction: How many activities are completed in my bucket list as per my SimpleNote note?
notes: Read-only question task: the evaluation requires no database changes, so the plan only gathers information. Passwords -> simple_note login -> search_notes with query 'bucket list' to discover the note id -> show_note to read the content and count the activities marked completed -> complete_task with that count as the answer. The count is a runtime object (completed-count) linked to the note via the static (answer-for ...) fact; the (query-for ...) fact links the search query to the note it reveals. supervisor-complete-task is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every other action.
